subject: Social Media
title: Is It Really Addiction
description: A short lesson to help you apply Is It Really Addiction.

hook.text: Parents say their kids are 'addicted' to phones. Psychologists debate whether that word even applies.

buildup.text: Clinical addiction requires tolerance, withdrawal, and impaired functioning. Some heavy users show all three.

discovery.text: The WHO recognizes gaming disorder but not social media addiction. The science hasn't settled the debate.

twist.text: Calling it addiction suits platforms poorly—it implies liability. They prefer 'overuse' or 'habit.'

climax.text: Whether or not it meets clinical criteria, millions report inability to stop. The label matters less than the suffering.

punchline.text: Call it what you want. They can't put it down.

quiz.question: Does the WHO officially recognize social media addiction?
options: No, only gaming disorder is recognized
